tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with the Secretary of Agriculture, shall establish a biofuels and biorefinery information center to make available to interested parties information on—

children.text: renewable fuel feedstocks, including the varieties of fuel capable of being produced from various feedstocks;
biorefinery processing techniques related to various renewable fuel feedstocks;
the distribution, blending, storage, and retail dispensing infrastructure necessary for the transport and use of renewable fuels;
Federal and State laws and incentives related to renewable fuel production and use;
renewable fuel research and development advancements;
renewable fuel development and biorefinery processes and technologies;
renewable fuel resources, including information on programs and incentives for renewable fuels;

tree.heading: Administration
tree.text: In administering the biofuels and biorefinery information center, the Secretary shall—

children.text: continually update information provided by the center;
make information available relating to processes and technologies for renewable fuel production;
make information available to interested parties on the process for establishing a biorefinery; and
make information and assistance provided by the center available through a toll-free telephone number and website.

tree.heading: Coordination and nonduplication
tree.text: To the maximum extent practicable, the Secretary shall ensure that the activities under this section are coordinated with, and do not duplicate the efforts of, centers at other government agencies.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as are necessary to carry out this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.

ancestors.heading: ENERGY SECURITY THROUGH INCREASED PRODUCTION OF BIOFUELS
